text:
elaine: Quick thread to lock final homepage & landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private + launch posts + webinar gating. Need hero, 1-line pitch, 3 bench bullets, CTA, and exact form hidden fields.
omar: I'll post two concise hero options for each mode (metric vs outcome).
li: I'll add microcopy for the form and the consult checkbox. Keep it short.
nate: Routing rules: hidden field lead_mode (hosted|dedicated|private), utm_campaign=launch_q2, consult_flag (true/false). Map hosted -> hosted_trial queue; dedicated/private -> enterprise_engage. If consult_flag==true tag=high_touch.
marta: I'll prepare three micro-bench blurbs (latency, embeddings, regulated) with a one-line method note.
omar: HERO OPTIONS:
HOSTED (metric): H1: "4x faster time-to-serve for common prompts." H2: "Hosted API with predictable latency and per-token pricing." CTA: "Try Hosted"
HOSTED (outcome): H1: "Ship LLM features, skip infra." H2: "Start in minutes, scale predictably." CTA: "Try Hosted"
DEDICATED (metric): H1: "Sustained throughput, predictable cost." H2: "Dedicated GPU pools and SLA controls." CTA: "Request Capacity"
DEDICATED (outcome): H1: "Capacity you can count on." H2: "Reserved pools, autoscale policies." CTA: "Request Capacity"
PRIVATE (metric): H1: "On-prem latency with cloud manageability." H2: "VPC, KMS, and audit-grade controls." CTA: "Talk to Sales"
PRIVATE (outcome): H1: "Inference inside your network." H2: "Full control and compliance." CTA: "Talk to Sales"
li: FORM MICROCOPY:
Visible fields: Name, Email, Company (optional), Role, Workload type (dropdown), Estimated tokens/month (optional), Message (optional)
Checkbox: "Yes, I'd like a capacity consult and agree to be contacted."
Privacy line: "We use your info to follow up about this request. See our privacy policy."
Hidden fields: lead_mode, utm_campaign=launch_q2, consult_flag
nate: WEBHOOK SAMPLE for eng: POST /api/lead payload: {name,email,company,role,workload_type,est_tokens,lead_mode,consult_flag,utm_campaign} routing: if lead_mode=="hosted" -> queue=hosted_trial; else -> queue=enterprise_engage; if consult_flag=="true" -> tag=high_touch
marta: BENCHMARK BLURBS (short): Latency-first: 25ms median tail (seq 256, A100) 10Method: prod traces sampled.
Embeddings: 3.1x throughput with batching (seq 512) 10Method: grouped requests baseline vs optimized.
Regulated: Full audit logs + KMS/HSM support 10Method: on-prem validation tests.
elaine: Webinar gating: gate full benchmark PDF behind registration. Webinar benefit one-liner: "Practical serving patterns to cut cost without raising tail latency." 3 takeaways: (1) architecture patterns; (2) batching & cache tactics; (3) rollout & rollback strategies. Speakers: CTO, Head of Infra, Solutions Eng.
omar: micro-CTAs under bullets: "See benchmark" linking to /benchmarks#launch-grid. Keep primary CTAs consistent: Try Hosted / Request Capacity / Talk to Sales.
li: UX note: confirmation page should surface a micro-benchmark snippet to build credibility after form submit. Also send follow-up email with benchmark PDF if consult_flag==true.
nate: deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2026-06-09T18:00Z; social scheduler queued 2026-06-10 09:00 UTC. Holding for copy freeze.
marta: I'll upload visuals and methodology tomorrow 09:00.
elaine: Thanks team. Please post here when staging copy is live and I'll sign off. :rocket:
